status: Production flat-list command adapter integrated and qualified; high-level controller and native input remain unfinished

contracts.implementation: One private command adapter core with constructor-fixed base/list facades; no duplicated publication, observation or generated-handle state machine
contracts.admission: Explicit V6, exact owned list render/profile generation and list bridge; base and foreign-owner requests reject before mutation
contracts.delivery: Private executor and live-token authority; selection prestage, atomic history/command publication, exact update/selection consumption and DOM restoration
contracts.content: Mode-specific exact Document JSON correlation, Session V6 checkpoint reader and bounded plain text
contracts.failure: Malformed generated results/cleanup failure fault permanently; post-publication DOM failure retains authoritative content and requires explicit render reconciliation
contracts.composition: Existing paragraph/heading behavior retained; list composition leases explicitly reject before mutation pending native-input integration
contracts.legacy: Base facade retains base request/result signatures and rejects list mode; shipping entry points unchanged

verification.browserScope: Real production list queue/adapter multiline insertion, exact undo/redo and selections, fresh Session V6 redo recovery, content readers, spent tokens, DOM-drift recovery, post-commit render failure and nonduplicating recovery/undo, idempotent disposal
developmentCorrections: The in-progress union refactor exposed TypeScript narrowing errors; fixed them with owned-render predicates and explicit base-only composition dependencies. Existing 1722 tests then passed, followed by all 1731 with new regressions.
